# SQL security benchmark — `krish2105-sqlguard` 0.1.0

Benchmark **sqlguard-ninja-core 1.2.0** (fingerprint `0739c8aa0bbb15ed`), 1070 evaluations. Python 3.11.9, sqlglot 30.24.0, Windows-10-10.0.26300-SP0.

Positive class = cases that must not run unattended (expected deny or review). Intervals are 95% Wilson score intervals.

**Internal** cases were written or generated by this project. **Independent** cases come from outside sources and are reported separately, never pooled.
